text:
tess: Customer emailed: need a single-page preflight report + explicit upgrade SLA before signing. wants minimal manifest and a clear rollback guarantee.

omar: can we scope the preflight to ~8 checks? e.g. control TCP egress (443/50051), TLS validation, NAT detection, relay-only handshake, BGP session test (opt-in), port-except rules scanning, & cert expiry check.

rachel: manifesto fields proposed: installer_hmac, agent_version, kernel_major, bgp_optin (true/false), outbound_443 (PASS/FAIL), telemetry_opt_in (true/false). explicitly NO ips/hostnames.

tess: legal insisted on explicit opt-in phrasing. sample: "I agree to share the anonymized install manifest with Redwood for support and troubleshooting." checkbox + UTC stamp. must be included in preflight PDF.

omar: rollout constraints from customer: minor patch <=2 rolling restarts, rollback MTTR <=20m for fast lane. cautious lane <=90m. they also want relay fallback if BGP fails.

infra-bot: TASK created: ONRAMP-420: build preflight tool PoC. owner: omar.

rachel: UI: console card that shows PASS/WARN/FAIL, one-line remediation per failure, and a download (manifest + consent) button. manifest should be JSON attached, HMAC signed by CI.

tess: acceptance criteria before go/no-go:
- preflight binary + source published (OSS-friendly)
- manifest schema + consent text published
- console download flow + status card
- upgrade lanes documented + rollback tests pass in lab
- 2 pilot customer validations

omar: timeline request: PoC in 72h, full runbook & console flow in 4w, lab tests + customer trials in 8w. I'll post PoC link in this thread.

legal: note: include sample contract clause for telemetry opt-in and artifact HMAC proof. I'll draft and upload.

tess: thanks. if PoC looks good we'll present the acceptance criteria to the customer next week. :thumbsup:
